items.description: Security hardening: fail2ban, UFW firewall rules, OAuth token fetch, parsed token fetch, company app.conf entries, secret_setting (proprietary — needs team input), sysctl kernel params, SSH sshd_config hardening via lineinfile
items.notes: Fix 1 (Cat4): Moved fail2ban service start/enable to AFTER the jail.local template task so fail2ban starts with the correct config on first run. Fix 2 (Cat2): Added stat check for /etc/ssh/sshd_config; both lineinfile tasks now have when: sshd_config_stat.stat.exists and create: false so they fail loudly instead of creating a stub file on hosts where openssh-server is absent.

items.description: Install nginx, deploy nginx.conf and security.conf, enable/start service, create document root dirs, deploy static index.html files for all three sites
items.notes: Added 'Create parent directory for site document roots' task (/opt/server) immediately before the document-root loop. Chef used recursive:true; Ansible file module does not auto-create parents, so the explicit parent task is required.
